# Breakthrough Interactive Lab

> The Impossible Room is a browser-based embodied AI experience where digital matter sees, touches, remembers and begins to anticipate the person in front of it.

## Main experience
- https://40daysuccess.com/interactive/ — The Impossible Room is the flagship experience. Supporting lab experiments explore its component capabilities: body tracking, physical matter, voice, memory, device motion and temporal interaction.

## Experiments
- Body + Matter: hand-tracked interaction with digital particles.
- Memory + Touch: a deformable field that remembers local traces.
- Voice + Matter: live microphone characteristics become interactive forms.
- Device + Space: device orientation and pointer movement control a spatial portal.
- Action + Time: a forty-day visualization that advances on real calendar days.
- Body + Time: a temporal mirror made from recent live camera frames.

## Privacy
Camera and microphone experiences are intended to process live media in the browser. The application does not intentionally upload or store camera or microphone recordings.

## Technology
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Canvas, MediaPipe browser vision, Web Audio, Device Orientation, WebGPU where supported, and progressive fallbacks.
